In 1933, Justice Louis Brandeis said: “We can have democracy in this country or we can have great wealth concentrated in the hands of the few, but we cannot have both.”

What he said was true 93 years ago. It’s even more accurate today.

Let us choose democracy over oligarchy.
My op-ed in the @latimes: latimes.com/opinion/story/20…

While the billionaires get much richer, 60% of working class Americans struggle to afford food or housing. Millions are losing healthcare.

Yes. The very rich should start paying their fair share of taxes. That’s why I support the California Wealth Tax on billionaires.

This is what kleptocracy looks like:
 
Last year, Meta gave Trump $25 million to settle a bogus lawsuit & $1 million for his inauguration.
 
This year, Trump gave Meta an $8 billion tax break lowering its tax rate to -23% this quarter.
 
That's a pretty good return on investment.

The world’s leading scientists are warning that AI could “end civilization as we know it.”
 
97% of Americans believe AI safety should be subject to rules.
 
When will our government wake up?! We need global cooperation — before it’s too late.

Video

I enjoyed speaking with hunger and nutrition advocates from Vermont this week. In the richest country in the history of the world, nobody should be going hungry. 

I thank these advocates for their tireless efforts.

The people building AI admit they may not be able to control it.

This is not science fiction—this is what experts are telling us.

That’s why I’m bringing together leading AI scientists from the U.S. and China to discuss the risks posed by AI. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1MJgNgYoo…

Ex-OpenAI board member Helen Toner says AI companies are "deadly serious" about building machines that outperform humans at everything and they don’t know if they’ll be able to control them.
 
So why hasn’t Congress taken meaningful action to regulate AI?

Video

The FCC is now threatening ABC's broadcast licenses, days after Donald Trump and Melania Trump demanded they fire Jimmy Kimmel.

This is straight out of the authoritarian playbook.

Mr. President: Read the Constitution. Freedom of speech is the First Amendment for good reason.

Young people in Vermont and across the country are, for good reasons, worried about the future.

Our job: make it better.

Video

A functioning democracy relies on the premise that people can express their political views freely without fear of being attacked or assassinated.

Political violence is political cowardice. It is unacceptable in all forms.
The existential risk of artificial intelligence.
RSVP: forms.office.com/Pages/Respo…

Uncontrolled AI poses a severe danger to all of humanity.

On Wednesday, I'll be hosting a discussion with leading AI scientists from the US and China about the need for international cooperation against this existential threat. This is an enormously important issue. Join us.

In public life, we all make misstatements.

Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said, "the American people are now paying the lowest costs in the world rather than the highest for prescription drugs."

That is an absurd statement.

Video

Trump is considering a large bailout for a multibillionaire dictator while he cuts health care for 15 million Americans.

This is insane. The working families of the United States need help, not one of the richest families in the world.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

KERNEN: Is there some type of currency swap possible with UAE to help if they need it? And do you think there'd be backlash?

TRUMP: It is. It's been a good country, a good ally of ours. It was shocking because we didn't think they'd get
Read my new Fox News op-ed: foxnews.com/opinion/sen-bern…

In the 1990s, the working class of this country was told that unfettered free trade would create millions of new jobs and raise wages.

As many of us understood then, that claim was a lie.

Now they’re being sold the same false promises about AI.

Dockworkers on the West Coast broke every productivity record — and are now being replaced by AI anyway.

This isn’t about efficiency. It’s about eliminating workers.

Video
There’s only a 10% chance that humanity is destroyed.
A better future is possible.
LIVE: Fighting Oligarchy in Detroit, MI with Abdul El Sayed, Donavan McKinney and Sara Nelson
LIVE: Fighting Oligarchy in Rochester, MN with Peggy Flanagan, Tina Smith and Keith Ellison
LIVE: Fighting Oligarchy in Ohio with Brian Poindexter, Rep. Deluzio and more
It’s not just massive job loss and the invasion of our privacy we should worry about.
Super PACs like AIPAC, AI and crypto are buying elections with billionaire money
Progressives are making real gains
LIVE: Sanders Joins More Perfect University Kick-off

If the world’s leading scientists say there’s even a 10% chance humanity could be destroyed because of uncontrolled AI, shouldn’t we do everything possible to prevent it? This isn’t about competition with China. It's about coming together to prevent what might be a catastrophe.

Detroit — thank you for an incredible turnout and event tonight. Passing Medicare for All. Increasing the minimum wage. Getting big money out of politics.  A better future is possible if we elect working-class champions like Dr. Abdul El-Sayed and Donavan McKinney to Congress.
A better future is possible.
Warming up in a local Minnesota park for the rally with @peggyflanagan.

Thank you Parma Heights for a packed house at our Fighting Oligarchy rally. Americans deserve leaders who have the courage to take on the billionaire class and fight for working people. That’s exactly the type of courage Brian Poindexter will bring to Congress.
He's surging by taking on the billionaire class and fighting for working families.  Americans are tired of status quo politics. They want REAL change and that's what Graham will deliver.

War in Iraq: $2.1 trillion War in Afghanistan: $2.3 trillion Projected cost of the war in Iran: $1 trillion Somehow, there is always money for war, but never enough money for housing, education or the needs of working people. We must and will change our national priorities.

The Democratic establishment spent millions on negative ads against Platner. The Republican establishment is spending millions on negative ads against Platner. Why? Not complicated. Because Graham is taking on oligarchy and fighting for the working people of Maine and the U.S.
